parameters.name: product_types
parameters.description: Finite set of product types indexed by p in P using 0-based indexing

parameters.name: unit_profit
parameters.description: Unit profit of each product type p

parameters.name: plastic_consumption
parameters.description: Plastic consumption coefficient per unit of each product type p

parameters.name: electronic_consumption
parameters.description: Electronic-component consumption coefficient per unit of each product type p

parameters.name: robot_product
parameters.description: Distinguished product type identifier for the robot

parameters.name: model_car_product
parameters.description: Distinguished product type identifier for the model car

parameters.name: building_blocks_product
parameters.description: Distinguished product type identifier for the building blocks

parameters.name: doll_product
parameters.description: Distinguished product type identifier for the doll

parameters.name: planning_horizon
parameters.description: Planning horizon count, equal to 1 for this single-period problem

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Number of units produced for each product type p

variables.name: manufacture_indicator
variables.description: Binary manufacturing indicator for each product type p

auxiliary_variables.name: big_m_production_bound
auxiliary_variables.description: Product-specific upper bound used to linearize the link between production quantities and manufacturing indicators; set as a valid upper bound on x_p for each product p

constraints.name: plastic_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total plastic consumption across all products must not exceed available plastic capacity

constraints.name: electronic_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Total electronic-component consumption across all products must not exceed available electronic-component capacity

constraints.name: production_requires_activation
constraints.description: Production is allowed only when the corresponding manufacturing indicator is active, and a product is considered manufactured only when its production quantity is positive

constraints.name: robot_excludes_doll
constraints.description: If the robot product type is manufactured, then the doll product type must not be manufactured

constraints.name: model_car_requires_building_blocks
constraints.description: If the model-car product type is manufactured, then the building-block product type must also be manufactured

constraints.name: doll_quantity_limit
constraints.description: The production quantity of dolls must not exceed the production quantity of model cars

constraints.name: single_period_decision
constraints.description: The solution must choose manufacturing and production decisions for the single period

constraints.name: nonnegative_integer_production
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative integers

constraints.name: binary_manufacturing_indicator
constraints.description: Manufacturing indicators must be binary variables

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize the total profit from all manufactured and sold toy units

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit from produced toy units across all product types.
